description: This file defines a CityAdapter class used to display a list of cities in a RecyclerView, with support for search highlighting and selection indication.

classes.name: CityAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter for displaying and interacting with a list of City objects, including search highlighting and selection handling.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Sets the list of cities to display and refreshes the view.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Updates the search query used for highlighting matching city and country names.

methods.name: setSelectedCity
methods.description: Marks a specific city as selected and updates the view.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new ViewHolder instance by inflating the item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds city data to the ViewHolder, including highlighting matches and setting visibility of the selected indicator.

methods.name: highlight
methods.description: Highlights parts of the text that match the query with color and bold style.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of city items currently in the list.
